_comment: Failed RTL sim tests that warrant a RELEASE Jira ticket. Matched by (config, group, filter, runner); an omitted field is a wildcard and `filter` is compared literally. First match wins, so keep wildcard entries last. '_'-prefixed fields are documentation only. Unlisted tests get no ticket.
_coverage: Full inventory of every Quasar test and which entry watches it: the release-test-evidence artifact, generated by tests/scripts/quasar/gen_test_coverage_doc.py.
_reaches_jira_today: Verified 2026-08-12. Only metal_unit_test_vcs_qsr feeds this matcher: it runs the config-1x3 rows of quasar_sim_regresion_tests.yaml and labels every row '1x3'. Other entries match rows in quasar_regression_tests.yaml / quasar_local_tests.yaml, which run in the emulator job that reports to Slack and does not write the manifest; they activate with no change here once it does.
_requirements_comment: AIIPSW requirements the release report accounts for, read from Jira 2026-08-20 (AIIPSW-10 gained six Trinity children within a week of the first read, so re-query rather than trust this list). evidence (read by the report, hence no underscore) states where the tests are and whether any CI job EXECUTES them -- existing, or compiling, is not evidence. It deliberately carries no test counts: those change whenever a test lands, and a stale number in a proof document costs more than the scale it conveys. Wired-row counts are computed by gen_test_coverage_doc.py; the report's own 'N of M requirements' is computed at run time. in_scope=false marks a requirement the Quasar gate can never cover (a different platform); those are listed once by key and excluded from the 'N of M' ratio, so the denominator only counts requirements this gate could in principle evidence.
_test_tracks_comment: Three Quasar test tracks; only (1) feeds this automation. (1) tests/scripts/quasar/*.yaml. (2) tt_metal/tt-llk/tests/python_tests/quasar/, run by its own run_quasar_regression.sh and skipped by the sim CI's simulator_paths.yml. (3) per-model op suites under models/.
